subject: Renewal QBR + Roadmap: staggered workstreams for demo week
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@clearlinehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: J. Patel <j.patel@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal QBR + Roadmap: staggered workstreams for demo week

Hi Soojin & Marissa —

Thanks again for the continued partnership. As we get closer to renewal, our executive team has asked for a short QBR plus a roadmap demo that spans a couple of short workstreams so we can align product, engineering, and security stakeholders without blocking on a single half-day session.

High-level ask: can Redwood run a "staggered workstreams" demo across two half-days next week (Tue/Wed) to allow our teams to attend the parts relevant to them? We expect ~12 attendees total (4 execs, 5 engineers, 3 security/compliance)--some will only join specific blocks.

Attachments: QBR_agenda_v2.pdf (agenda, 3 blocks per day)

Questions for you:
- Are separate recordings per block possible?
- Can you provide an exec-friendly 15-min slot (recorded) for our CPO?
- Any constraints for simultaneous hands-on demos (we may want a breakout for an engineer deep-dive)

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Product Operations
Clearline Health

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + Roadmap: staggered workstreams for demo week

Marta —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can definitely run a staggered format and produce per-block recordings. Quick outline/proposal below; attaching a lightweight ops checklist (SOW_draft_pagecounts.xlsx) with headcounts per block.

Proposed format (high level):
- Day 1 (Tue): Platform + Integrations (60m), Performance & Cost playbook (45m), Exec Q&A (15m)
- Day 2 (Wed): Security & Compliance deep-dive (45m), Hands-on engineer breakout (60m), Roadmap + next steps (30m)

Notes/constraints:
- Recordings: yes, each block recorded separately and shared within 24 hours.
- Hands-on breakout: we'll need a minimum of 6 engineers in a breakout VM cluster; recommend we run the engineer lab at a reduced token limit (to avoid service throttles) or provide pre-warmed dedicated capacity for the 60m lab.
- Exec slot: Ben can run the 15-min CPO-friendly overview and we can capture a 5-min highlight clip tailored for the CPO.

Can you confirm preferred local times for your East/West attendees? If we keep blocks in a 9:00–13:30 PT window over two days, that should work for both coasts.

I'll set up a calendar with proposed times after I get your time preferences.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marta Ruiz <mruiz@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + Roadmap: staggered workstreams for demo week

Marta / team —

Agree with Soojin's format. Operational follow-ups:
- I can own attendee invites and recording permissions. Please send final list of attendees & roles by EOD Monday so I can provision access.
- Grace will liaise with your security contact to prep the compliance appendix and ensure we have audit log examples available in the Security block.
- For the hands-on lab, recommend we provide a short pre-read and a playback recording option in case anyone can't join live.

Small ask on timing: if your CPO prefers a mid-day digest, we can schedule the 15-min exec slot at 11:30 PT on Tue. Ben, can you confirm availability for that slot?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + Roadmap: staggered workstreams for demo week

Marissa —

11:30 PT Tue works for me. I'll prepare the 15-min CPO overview and a 5-min highlight reel we can send to execs who can't attend live. I'll also bring a short slide on Dedicated vs Hosted capacity for their SLA questions.

Operational note: if you want guaranteed throughput for the hands-on lab, recommend we provision a small dedicated pool for the 60m breakouts. Cost estimate included in SOW_draft_pagecounts.xlsx (tab: DedicatedOptions). If Clearline wants to avoid the cost, we can run the lab on pre-warmed hosted capacity with recommended throttles.

Ben Carter
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, J. Patel <j.patel@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + Roadmap: staggered workstreams for demo week

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround.

Confirming:
- Tue, 2027-06-01 11:30–11:45 PT: CPO exec overview (Ben)
- Tue, 2027-06-01 09:00–13:00 PT: Day 1 blocks (Platform, Perf & Cost, Exec)
- Wed, 2027-06-02 09:00–13:00 PT: Day 2 blocks (Security, Lab breakout, Roadmap)
- We will provide attendee list by 2027-05-31 18:00 PT (attached final attendee spreadsheet).

Marta Ruiz
Head of Product Operations
Clearline Health
